dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Well, though this place is just as new and unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: It's different from when I first arrived in Sumeru or Mondstadt. I don't feel that mix of excitement and unease. I feel safe and comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's good to hear. If you need anything, just let me know!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Thank you, but... but this place already has everything. I don't need anything more.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: If anything, there's too much. Some things will be wasted on me.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: For example, the soft bed that you prepared for me. Perhaps it could go to another guest who needs it?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: And don't worry, I haven't used it.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'll fold the bedding and put it back in the closet. A very capable maid taught me how to do it, and I've been looking for a chance to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? Was the bed not comfortable?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: The bed is fine. It's just that I'm more used to sleeping in confined spaces. I feel safer that way.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I've already found a few suitable places. The small sofa. And inside the wardrobe.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: And since there aren't any cats here to come and scratch me because I've taken their favorite spot, every night is a good night's sleep.

choices.text: Uh-oh... I actually do have cats.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Oh... In that case, I'll let them have first pick and then I can find somewhere else. I wouldn't want to scare 'em...

choices.text: Don't worry, my cats don't scare easily.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Starting tonight, I'll be sure to leave a little space before I go to sleep.

choices.text: They'll probably try to curl up beside you.
I'll make you your own little "lair"!

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Will you draw one for me, like Albedo? W—Would that be too much trouble?

choices.text: I'm sorry, I'm not that good at alchemy.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: I've never had a lair like this before... I'll treasure it.

response.speaker: Durin
response.text: Please, allow me to help you!

choices.text: But I can make one myself, no sweat!
